name: work-breakdown-structure
description: Create a work breakdown structure (WBS) from scope + deliverables. Hierarchical decomposition (100% rule, mutually exclusive siblings), work-package sizing (8/80 rule), deliverable-oriented vs phase-oriented vs responsibility-oriented decomposition, WBS dictionary entries, milestone identification, intra-WBS dependencies, numbering (1.1.2.3). Outputs: tree view + WBS dictionary + milestones + top-level dependencies. Not a schedule — hand off to release-planning / Gantt for timing. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
